notes.title: Power Gem Fetcher's first update!
notes.content:
Power Gem Fetcher got a HUGE update! Now you can finally CHANGE your sword, and you even use SHIELDS as well. Also, there's a brand new crafting system where you craft your potions, equipment, etc.
This update came with some sprite changes and a few bug fixes.
